title: RecordEntry
description: One entry of the append-only, hash-chained trust record (EA-6.7 to EA-6.11).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with milliseconds and a Z suffix (EA-6.11).

body.description: Type-specific content: references, labels and hashes only, never customer content (EA-6.14). A decision body follows decision.schema.json plus routing fields; an outcome body follows outcome-event.schema.json.

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of sequence, timestamp, type, body and previous_hash (EA-6.8).
